scope: Synthetic saved captures across all four model/capacity definitions, plus one separately scoped FM9 12.00 physical modifier-value edit
implementation: Exact capture-backed modifier value calibration through shared CLI, planner and local MCP adapter
coverage: Complete witness hashes, stable saved slot, 25-word modifier record, exact source/target binding and uniquely placed target block
One differing settings word, source-mapped key/word agreement, exact current/requested witnesses and no interpolation
Changed modifier or target-block context, stale binding, unit mismatch and conflicting assignments refuse planning

fm9_12_00_initial_witness_attempt.scope: Caller-operated modifier changes and integrity-checked saved reads; the calibrated modifier setter was not executed
fm9_12_00_initial_witness_attempt.result: No stable-binding, one-settings-word pair was obtained. Assignment changes affected binding and initialization words; another change created a different modifier assignment. These captures cannot calibrate a numeric display value.
fm9_12_00_initial_witness_attempt.recovery: A guarded single-preset restore verified the original loaded, saved and reloaded image. Its post-restore inventory stopped early after a MIDI receive-channel closure. A fresh saved read matched the original wire, raw and body hashes; a separate checkpointed read-only inventory completed and all 512 saved slots matched the pre-test inventory in wire, raw and body hashes. The original selection and scene were then restored by a guarded Load.
fm9_12_00_initial_witness_attempt.limits: The early inventory failure and a later excess of unrelated MIDI replies were recorded; the latter read-only scan resumed and completed. No effective modifier response, numeric display mapping or calibrated setter persistence was qualified.

fm9_12_00_hardware_setter_trial.scope: One existing 25-word modifier record on FM9 12.00; two caller-labelled saved captures with stable binding and target context differed in exactly one named curve word
fm9_12_00_hardware_setter_trial.calibration: Offline resolver accepted the two integrity-checked exact witnesses. Their labels qualify only this observed context, not a general display scale.
fm9_12_00_hardware_setter_trial.execution: One set-calibrated-modifier persistent edit passed guarded upload, saved verification and reload. An independent saved read matched the pre-test image exactly in wire, raw and decoded-body hashes.
fm9_12_00_hardware_setter_trial.preservation: A checkpointed post-edit read-only inventory completed after a receive-noise interruption. All 512 saved slots matched the pre-test full inventory in wire, raw and decoded-body hashes. A guarded Load restored the original selected preset and scene without discarding changes.
fm9_12_00_hardware_setter_trial.limits: The tested direction was from one exact witnessed value to another in one modifier context. Effective pedal response, display readback after the toolkit write, other values/fields, other firmware and other models remain unqualified. A concurrently open editor was reported during unrelated MIDI replies in the inventory; no write was replayed.

limits: Capture labels and origin are caller-declared; synthetic witnesses do not establish hardware calibration
Exact witnessed values only; no general display conversion, time-unit law or selector-name mapping inferred
Only single-word values in parsed 25-word modifier records; other storage layouts remain unqualified
One exact FM9 12.00 modifier-value edit passed saved persistence; effective behavior and broader model/firmware applicability remain untested
